name: Visit eVisa (Ministerial Resolution No. 142 of 2019)

requirements.blocker_text: Must hold a passport from one of 212 eVisa-eligible nationalities.
3-month bank statement showing monthly income of BHD 300-500, or BHD 150 per day of stay.

sources.title: Bahrain.bh eGovernment portal -- Visit eVisa: 212 eligible nationalities, single-entry 2-week validity, BHD 9 visa fee + BHD 4 application fee, BHD 300-500/month or BHD 150/day funds requirement, 3-5 working day processing, administered by NPRA under Ministerial Resolution No. 142 of 2019

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Bahrain). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- directly fetched and confirmed from Bahrain's own eGovernment portal, tier-1. Fee split into a BHD 9 visa fee and a BHD 4 application fee, not itemized further here. No distinct 'business visitor' variant with different terms was confirmed alongside this general eVisa in this pass -- disclosed as a possible gap rather than assumed identical.
